description: Index of the 441 domains (all mask prefixes of length 6) of the (S1) certificate tree for r = 10. Each domain is one xz-compressed certificate tree with header domain_prefix = prefix; the domain intervals partition the mixed-radix tree. SHA-256 of the compressed files: s1_depth10_certificates.sha256; of the uncompressed trees: s1_depth10_trees.sha256. The domain files are in the separate deposit file; see README.md.
